description: This file defines a factory class for creating middleware instances in a Slim framework application. It binds container dependencies to a middleware constructor for handling request parameters.

classes.name: ParamsMiddlewareFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and binding middleware with dependency injection in a Slim framework context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with a dependency injection container.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Creates a middleware callable that injects container dependencies into ParamsMiddleware for request processing.
